question: Defeating which country has India been crowned champions of the Asia Cup 2025 hockey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Korea.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India defeated South Korea 4-1 to win the Asia Cup 2025 hockey championship.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India defeated South Korea in the final, claiming their fourth Asia Cup hockey title.**
 
• Dilpreet Singh scored a brace, while Sukhjeet Singh and Amit Rohidas added to India’s tally in the final match.
 
• India’s victory also secured their qualification for the 2026 FIH Hockey World Cup.
 
• India ended an eight-year wait for the Asia Cup title with this convincing 4-1 win.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Hockey Asia Cup__

 __
 
• One of the most prestigious hockey tournaments in Asia, featuring the top national teams from across the continent.
 
 
 
• Dilpreet Singh__
 __
 
• Played a crucial role in India’s victory, scoring two goals in the final match.
 
 
 
• Qualification for the World Cup__
 
 
• India’s win in the Asia Cup secured their spot in the 2026 Hockey World Cup in the Netherlands and Belgium.
